body: Activation steering has shown promise for controlling LLM generation along well-defined attributes, but it remains unclear whether it can handle the multidimensional and hard-to-define nature of authorship style. We ask whether structured contrastive prompting along rhetorically-motivated dimensions can construct rich style representations directly in activation space, bypassing the need for natural language style descriptors or dedicated training. We find that the resulting directions share a common authorship backbone while conflicting on aspect-specific residuals that carry genuine stylistic signal, explaining why naive aggregation fails. We operationalize this in Aspect-Aware Activation Steering (A3S), a training-free framework that merges per-aspect contrastive directions with interference-aware aggregation and tunes steering strength per instance. A3S improves authorship style transfer where it is genuinely multi-aspect, outperforms a trained baseline in preference evaluations on out-of-domain benchmarks, and keeps target-exemplar overlap consistently low.
summaryZh: 本研究探讨了激活引导（Activation Steering）技术在捕捉和控制大语言模型（LLM）多维度作者风格方面的潜力。研究发现，通过沿修辞学驱动的维度进行结构化对比提示，可以直接在激活空间构建丰富的风格表示，无需依赖自然语言风格描述或专门训练。结果显示，不同风格维度产生的方向共享一个共同的作者风格基础，但在携带真实风格信号的方面特定残差上存在冲突，解释了为何简单聚合会失败。为此，研究提出了Aspect-Aware Activation Steering (A3S)框架，该框架融合了每方面对比方向，并采用干扰感知聚合，同时为每个实例调整引导强度。A3S在真正多方面的作者风格迁移任务上表现优于训练基线，并在跨领域基准测试的偏好评估中胜出，同时保持了目标示例的低重叠度。
